content.value_statement: Architecture reviews often miss project-specific rules across backend, frontend, and documentation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a strict checklist for consistent review results.
actual_capabilities: Checks backend package structure, naming, controllers, services, DTOs, MyBatis, Flyway, error codes, and OpenAPI updates.
Checks frontend TypeScript, React Hooks, Next.js App Router, shadcn/ui, component design, forms, and performance rules.
Requires relevant architecture, coding rule, policy, database, and feature documents before review findings are written.
Separates required fixes from recommended improvements in pass and fail review reports.
Compares review depth with project GitHub Actions review workflows and avoids repeated resolved comments.
Produces structured handoff guidance for developer teams and QA reviewers.
limitations: The checklist is tailored to MovieMarketer project conventions and may need adaptation for other repositories.
The skill does not run tests, linters, or type checks unless the assistant uses external tools.
Review quality depends on available project documents, changed files, and prior review context.
Best-practice lookups and browser performance checks require the referenced MCP tools to be available.

use_cases.title: Review backend pull requests
use_cases.description: Assess Spring Boot, MyBatis, Flyway, OpenAPI, and error-code changes against project standards.

use_cases.title: Review frontend pull requests
use_cases.description: Check TypeScript, React Hooks, Next.js App Router, shadcn/ui, forms, and component boundaries.

use_cases.title: Validate release readiness
use_cases.description: Confirm code, database, API, and documentation changes are aligned before QA handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Basic architecture review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when you want a general review of a pull request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current pull request with the review-architecture skill. Read the required project documents, inspect changed files, and report required fixes first.

prompt_templates.title: Backend compliance review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for Java, Spring Boot, database, or API changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the backend changes for architecture compliance. Focus on package structure, naming, service design, MyBatis, Flyway, error codes, and OpenAPI documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Frontend compliance review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for React, Next.js, and UI component changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the frontend changes for architecture compliance. Focus on TypeScript strict rules, React Hooks, App Router, shadcn/ui usage, forms, and component separation.

prompt_templates.title: Full release gate review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before a merge or QA handoff for broad changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a full architecture gate review. Compare backend, frontend, database, API, and documentation changes, then issue a pass or fail decision with concrete file-level fixes.

output_examples.input: A backend pull request adds a user profile endpoint and a new validation error.
output_examples.output: Overall decision: fail. Required fixes include adding the new error code to documentation, correcting endpoint naming, and replacing duplicated user lookup logic.

output_examples.input: A frontend pull request adds a settings form using custom controls and several hooks.
output_examples.output: Overall decision: fail. Required fixes include using existing shadcn/ui controls, correcting hook dependencies, and moving visibility logic to the container layer.

output_examples.input: A documentation-only pull request updates the database design and feature specification.
output_examples.output: Overall decision: pass. The documents are consistent with the stated feature behavior, and only minor wording improvements are suggested.

best_practices: Provide the pull request diff and relevant project documents before requesting a final decision.
Ask for required fixes and recommended improvements as separate sections.
Confirm whether the change is backend, frontend, database, API, documentation, or mixed scope.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a pass decision before the required documents are reviewed.
Do not use the checklist as a substitute for automated tests, linters, or type checks.
Do not apply MovieMarketer-specific rules blindly to unrelated project architectures.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews backend, frontend, database, API, and documentation changes against project architecture rules.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It defines the review process, but tool execution depends on the assistant and available environment.

faq.question: Can it review non-MovieMarketer projects?
faq.answer: Yes, but the checklist is project-specific and should be adapted before use in other repositories.

faq.question: Does it support both backend and frontend reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes separate backend and frontend review phases with different technical checks.

faq.question: How does it decide pass or fail?
faq.answer: It requires all mandatory architecture, coding, documentation, and prohibited-pattern checks to pass.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect a structured review report with a pass or fail decision, required fixes, recommendations, and next steps.
